//region: Region is deliberately NOT pinned here. The CLI reads a top-level 'region'
key and it outranks AWS_REGION, which would silently override the Makefile's
GO2_REGION (`make deploy-agentcore GO2_REGION=us-west-2`) and put the stack
in one region while that target's aws calls used another -- the exact split
the old deploy script existed to prevent. The Makefile pins AWS_REGION /
AWS_DEFAULT_REGION, the CLI turns that into CDK_DEFAULT_REGION, and
bin/app.ts defaults to us-east-1 if it is unset. Assets follow the stack's
env, so they cannot diverge from it.
//requireApproval: The Fargate and AgentCore stacks both change IAM and security groups, which
otherwise prompts on every deploy. Set here rather than as a flag so every
entry point (make, npm, bare cdk) behaves identically.

//: Deploy knobs, read at synth time. Override with --context key=value, e.g.
deviceId is read ONCE in bin/app.ts and passed to all three stacks as a
required prop -- it names the KVS stream (<deviceId>-camera) and the IoT
topic prefix, and every stack has to address the same names. It used to be
a separate CfnParameter per stack, i.e. three values to keep in sync by
hand. Changing it REPLACES the KVS stream, so treat it as a new robot.
novaSonicVoice is Go2AgentCoreStack's alone. modelRegion is absent on
purpose: that stack falls back to its own region, keeping the demo
single-region however it is deployed. Set it only when deploying somewhere
